text: The second-order nonlinear susceptibility χ⁽²⁾ (which enables second-harmonic generation and the Pockels effect) is exactly zero in which materials?
choices: Centrosymmetric materials such as crystalline silicon and amorphous silica
Only in gases, never in solids
explanation: χ⁽²⁾ vanishes in any material with inversion (centrosymmetric) symmetry, including silicon and silica — which is why they show no Pockels effect. LiNbO₃ and GaAs lack inversion symmetry and have large χ⁽²⁾; the effect is not restricted to gases.
